doc: Dash -> ability rows (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). dash.<ground|air>.<lmb|rmb|e|x|q>: {mode: fire (mid-dash) | buffer (to the dash's end; the default for a missing row) | cancel (ends the dash), carry: dash momentum kept into it, variant: a dash-variant name the kit reads, source: what the source hero does}. into_dash.<slot>: the same for Shift pressed during that ability's wind-up or recovery. kit_owns: the dashes (ground, air) the kit runs in its own state, out of DashFlow's sight until it overrides ArchKit.in_dash(). Combo rows (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): jump.<slot> (a press mid-jump: fire | buffer to the landing), into_jump.<slot> (a jump in the ability's wind-up or recovery: fire | cancel | buffer | lock; into_dash takes the same modes and an optional air sub-row), hold.<slot>.<ground|air|jump|mantle> (a held slot through that move: keep | cancel). A missing row combines; any other row is an exception and carries a reason and a source. held_fire.<dash|rmb|e|x|q|all>: {source, ours}: notes for the held-LMB rows (docs only: LMB is a held input everywhere, Hunter.trigger reads the key every frame and fire resumes the frame a slot's lock ends; --held-fire-resume-check). window.source: the footage evidence for the buffer window (DashFlow.BUFFER_S), shown in docs/heroes/dash_interactions.md. dash_jump.<ground|air|rise|same>: Space in a ground dash, Space in an air dash, Shift in a jump's rise, both on one step: {ours: cancel | both | ignore | end | buffer | dash (measured, --dash-jump-check), carry: share of the dash's speed kept, source, verdict: match | [?] (the source doesn't settle it)}.

lmb.source: Footage tip 'Punch to Extend Dash/RMB': a punch during Landslide goes off and carries her on. Ours: the boulder or punch goes off mid-hop and the hop's arc carries on (a punch's step pushes him a little further); every hop of a Rock Hop chain counts as the dash.

rmb.source: Footage tip 'Dash -> RMB Dunk Combo' (0965-1010): Landslide shoves the foe out, then she leap-slams onto it. Ours: the charge starts mid-hop; let go in the air and the slam lands where the hop does, which ends the chain there.

e.source: Card: Rockwave is only castable over ground; nothing on casting it mid-Landslide. Ours: held to the end of the chain, then raised from there.

x.source: Not in the data or footage. Tetraform is placed at the cursor, not at her, so the aim starts mid-hop; the ridge rises on release.

q.source: Not in the data or footage (the glove is ours). It goes off mid-hop like any glove.

lmb.source: Item 183: with a charge, the air dash is the same Rock Hop as the ground one (the source has one Landslide, no air variant), so the punch goes off mid-hop and the hop carries on, as on the ground.

rmb.source: Item 183: the same Rock Hop as on the ground, so the charge starts mid-hop and the slam lands where the hop does. With no charge left the shared long dash runs and the dive waits for its end.

e.source: Card: Rockwave is only castable over ground, so it doesn't go off in the air at all (with or without a dash).

x.source: Item 183: the same Rock Hop as on the ground. The aim is placed at the cursor, so it starts mid-hop.

q.source: Not in the data or footage (the glove is ours). It goes off mid-hop like any glove.

lmb.source: Not in the data or footage. Shift during the punch's wind-up hops at once; the hold carries on and the punch goes on release.

rmb.source: Footage: jumping while charging leaps her forward with the circle; Shift during the charge does the same with Rock Hop (the circle comes along, the charge carries on).

e.source: Not in the data or footage. The rocks are already placed during the 0.2s flash; Shift hops at once and they rise anyway.

x.source: Not in the data or footage. Shift while aiming the ridge hops at once; the aim carries on.

all.source: Data: Quake Fist is hold and release, no timeout; the key is a held input.
all.ours: A cast that stops the fists drops the charge with no punch; the key still down starts a fresh hold the step she is free (0 frames).

window.source: Tarek (breah.md 0985-0997, 246-249 s): dash at 0985/0986, the KNOCK beam at 0989-0990; with the RMB hop's own 0.4 s, the RMB press fell within a frame of the dash's end and was kept.

glide_rows.source: Owner rule, briefs/DECISIONS.md 2026-11-08: Shift cancels into glide instantly for every Hunter; glide opens only on a press, never a hold. Source rows for this dash: the air dash rows above.
glide_rows.ours: a fresh press ends the dash that step and the glider opens the next, keeping the dash speed up to the handoff cap. The air dash is the Rock Hop chain: the press ends it. Asserted in --airdash-glide-check.

glide_rows.source: Not determinable: no source row for a glide pressed after this Hunter's abilities (data and footage silent). Kept: owner item 162b, no glider inside an ability's animation (docs/MOVEMENT_FEEL.md).
glide_rows.ours: glide opens when the move's keys end, pressed after a tap: LMB 0.55 s; RMB 2.73 s; E n/a; X 1.00 s; Q at once (n/a: the press did not go off in the air in the check).

glide_rows.source: Not determinable: same as above. Kept: owner item 162b, a hold keeps the glider shut (Kael 113.2, Grimble bug 26 pattern stays).
glide_rows.ours: glide pressed 0.3 s into a hold: LMB n/a; RMB shut while held; E n/a; X 0.73 s; Q at once.
